tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id (from search results, e.g. "c3:2yh8WH5") with every known offer, one per merchant, cheapest first. Prices are USD. Give the user best.buy_url (a link we may earn a commission on; disclose that). as_of says how fresh each price is.

tools.name: get_comparison
tools.description: Get a curated, regularly refreshed price comparison for a popular category. Default sort is relevance; use sort=price_asc for cheapest first. Prices are USD. Give the user best.buy_url (a link we may earn a commission on; disclose that). as_of says how fresh each price is.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Get today's biggest discounts across all categories and stores (good for Black Friday / Cyber Monday deal questions) (default sort=discount, list price required).
